configuration.lda_baseline: shrinkage LDA on training-speaker utterance means only; calibration/evaluation data excluded
configuration.model_selection: minimum pairwise verification EER on model-selection speakers at 10s registration and 3s query; threshold is diagnostic only and is refit from calibration speakers
configuration.normalization: per-input-dimension center/scale fit on head-training utterances only; scale floor 1e-4; z-score clamp +/-8
configuration.seed_protocol: speaker fold seed plus fixed representation/objective offsets; per-batch sampler seeded; deterministic torch algorithms
configuration.training_inputs: cached pooled frozen Nemotron frame features; no audio encoder or pretrained speaker model
